cleanup.boundary: The artifact measures kill -0 of the direct simctl launch driver. It does not independently prove native application termination or simulator deletion: inherited cleanup suppresses simctl terminate/shutdown/delete failures.
cleanup.xctest_launch_driver_wait_basis: The XCTest artifact reports TEST EXECUTE SUCCEEDED, and the unchanged shell reaches its final passed phase only after a successful wait for its owned xcodebuild launch child. This is separate from the direct simctl console-driver kill -0 records.

local_reverification: Passed unchanged verify-ios-smoke.py for all seven sequential snapshots using original Start baseline and each exact URI; additionally each warm snapshot timestamp follows its request. Unchanged verify-ios-devices.py passed real provider evidence.

runtime_build.source: Smoke uses steps.bundle.outputs.app, produced by the optional carrier build after the standard build.
runtime_build.qualification: Simulator evidence does not qualify entitled physical-device carrier operations.

authorization_summary.boundary: The first retained mounted Start observation is sequence 2 and reports Unknown; all six later warm captures report Prompt. This directly records the observed transition in this main run, not the exact first application frame or delegate callback time, and does not grant location authorization.

bootstrap_timing.basis: The first URL request is written only after the shell observes phase=ready. Its timestamp bounds readiness observation from above, not the exact ready publication time. The XCTest Start Test marker is reported at elapsed 0.29s and is recorded as a marker rather than asserted to be exact test-method entry. Runner log timestamps use UTC.

runtime_startup_observations.boundary: The standard UIKit build took 483 seconds and the simulator runtime step took 308 seconds. Observed readiness completed within the 240-second allowance and also below the former 120-second limit. The recorded simulator waits do not establish a lower-level cause.
